items.text:
गवां संरक्षणार्थाय न दुष्येद्रोधबन्धयोः ।
तद्वधं तु न तं विद्यात्कामाकामकृतं तथा ॥ ९.१ ॥
items.tr:
gavāṃ saṃrakṣaṇārthāya na duṣyedrodhabandhayoḥ |
tadvadhaṃ tu na taṃ vidyātkāmākāmakṛtaṃ tathā || 9.1 ||
items.en: A man is not at fault for penning or tying cows in order to protect them. Such a death should not be treated as killing, whether it was intended or not.

items.text:
दण्डादूर्ध्वं यदन्येन प्रहाराद्यदि पातयेत् ।
प्रायश्चित्तं तदा प्रोक्तं द्विगुणं गोवधे चरेत् ॥ ९.२ ॥
items.tr:
daṇḍādūrdhvaṃ yadanyena prahārādyadi pātayet |
prāyaścittaṃ tadā proktaṃ dviguṇaṃ govadhe caret || 9.2 ||
items.en: If he kills a cow with a blow from something other than a stick, then he should perform double the atonement for cow-killing.

items.text:
रोधबन्धनयोक्त्राणि घातश्चेति चतुर्विधम् ।
एकपादं चरेद्रोधे द्वौ पादौ बन्धने चरेत् ॥ ९.३ ॥
items.tr:
rodhabandhanayoktrāṇi ghātaśceti caturvidham |
ekapādaṃ caredrodhe dvau pādau bandhane caret || 9.3 ||
items.en: Penning, tying, yoking and striking: these are the four kinds. For penning he does one quarter of the penance, and for tying two quarters.

items.text:
योक्त्रेषु पादहीनं स्याच्चरेत्सर्वं निपातने ।
गोवाटे वा गृहे वापि दुर्गे वाप्यसमस्थले ॥ ९.४ ॥
items.tr:
yoktreṣu pādahīnaṃ syāccaretsarvaṃ nipātane |
govāṭe vā gṛhe vāpi durge vāpyasamasthale || 9.4 ||
items.en: For yoking, three quarters; for striking it down, the whole penance. In a cow-pen, a house, a hard-to-reach place or on uneven ground,

items.text:
नदीष्वथ समुद्रेषु त्वन्येषु न नदीमुखे ।
दग्धदेशे मृता गावः स्तम्भनाद्रोध उच्यते ॥ ९.५ ॥
items.tr:
nadīṣvatha samudreṣu tvanyeṣu na nadīmukhe |
dagdhadeśe mṛtā gāvaḥ stambhanādrodha ucyate || 9.5 ||
items.en: … in rivers, in seas or other waters but not at a river mouth, or in a burnt area: if cows die there from being held in, this is called 'penning'.
items.note: These two verses are hard to follow; the list of places seems to describe where a penned cow may die.

items.text:
योक्त्रदामकदोरैश्च कण्ठाभरणभूषणैः ।
गृहे वापि वने वापि बद्धा स्याद्गौर्मृता यदि ॥ ९.६ ॥
items.tr:
yoktradāmakadoraiśca kaṇṭhābharaṇabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
gṛhe vāpi vane vāpi baddhā syādgaurmṛtā yadi || 9.6 ||
items.en: If a cow dies while tied with yoke-ropes, cords, strings or neck ornaments, whether at home or in the forest,

items.text:
तदेव बन्धनं विद्यात्कामाकामकृतं च यत् ।
हले वा शकटे पङ्क्तौ पृष्ठे वा पीडितो नरैः ॥ ९.७ ॥
items.tr:
tadeva bandhanaṃ vidyātkāmākāmakṛtaṃ ca yat |
hale vā śakaṭe paṅktau pṛṣṭhe vā pīḍito naraiḥ || 9.7 ||
items.en: … that should be known as 'tying', whether done on purpose or not. If an animal is overworked by men at the plough, in a cart, in a team, or carrying loads on its back,

items.text:
गोपतिर्मृत्युं आप्नोति योक्त्रो भवति तद्वधः ।
मत्तः प्रमत्त उन्मत्तश्चेतनो वाप्यचेतनः ॥ ९.८ ॥
items.tr:
gopatirmṛtyuṃ āpnoti yoktro bhavati tadvadhaḥ |
mattaḥ pramatta unmattaścetano vāpyacetanaḥ || 9.8 ||
items.en: … and the bull dies, that death counts as 'yoking'. If a man, whether drunk, careless, mad, aware or unaware,

items.text:
कामाकामकृतक्रोधो दण्डैर्हन्यादथोपलैः ।
प्रहृता वा मृता वापि तद्धि हेतुर्निपातने ॥ ९.९ ॥
items.tr:
kāmākāmakṛtakrodho daṇḍairhanyādathopalaiḥ |
prahṛtā vā mṛtā vāpi taddhi heturnipātane || 9.9 ||
items.en: … strikes a cow with sticks or stones in anger, on purpose or not, and the cow is hurt or dies, that is the case of 'striking down'.

items.text:
अङ्गुष्ठमात्रस्थूलस्तु बाहुमात्रः प्रमाणतः ।
आद्रस्तु सपलाशश्च दण्ड इत्यभिधीयते ॥ ९.१० ॥
items.tr:
aṅguṣṭhamātrasthūlastu bāhumātraḥ pramāṇataḥ |
ādrastu sapalāśaśca daṇḍa ityabhidhīyate || 9.10 ||
items.en: A 'stick' means one as thick as a thumb and as long as an arm, green and with its leaves on.

items.text:
मूर्छितः पतितो वापि दण्डेनाभिहितः स तु ।
उत्थितस्तु यदा गच्छेत्पञ्च सप्त दशैव वा ॥ ९.११ ॥
items.tr:
mūrchitaḥ patito vāpi daṇḍenābhihitaḥ sa tu |
utthitastu yadā gacchetpañca sapta daśaiva vā || 9.11 ||
items.en: If a cow struck with a stick faints or falls, but then gets up and walks five, seven or ten steps,

items.text:
ग्रासं वा यदि गृह्णीयात्तोयं वापि पिबेद्यदि ।
पूर्वं व्याध्युपसृष्टश्चेत्प्रायश्चित्तं न विद्यते ॥ ९.१२ ॥
items.tr:
grāsaṃ vā yadi gṛhṇīyāttoyaṃ vāpi pibedyadi |
pūrvaṃ vyādhyupasṛṣṭaścetprāyaścittaṃ na vidyate || 9.12 ||
items.en: … or takes a mouthful of grass or drinks water, and it was already sick before, then no atonement is needed.

items.text:
पिण्डस्थे पादं एकं तु द्वौ पादौ गर्भसंमिते ।
पादोनं व्रतं उद्दिष्टं हत्वा गर्भं अचेतनम् ॥ ९.१३ ॥
items.tr:
piṇḍasthe pādaṃ ekaṃ tu dvau pādau garbhasaṃmite |
pādonaṃ vrataṃ uddiṣṭaṃ hatvā garbhaṃ acetanam || 9.13 ||
items.en: If a calf in the womb is killed while still a lump, one quarter; when it has taken the shape of a foetus, two quarters; for killing a foetus not yet alive, three quarters of the vow.

items.text:
पादेऽङ्गरोमवपनं द्विपादे श्मश्रुणोऽपि च ।
त्रिपादे तु शिखा वर्जं सशिखं तु निपातने ॥ ९.१४ ॥
items.tr:
pāde'ṅgaromavapanaṃ dvipāde śmaśruṇo'pi ca |
tripāde tu śikhā varjaṃ saśikhaṃ tu nipātane || 9.14 ||
items.en: For one quarter, he shaves his body hair; for two quarters, also the beard; for three quarters, everything except the tuft; for the full penance, the tuft as well.

items.text:
पादे वस्त्रयुगं चैव द्विपादे कांस्यभाजनम् ।
त्रिपादे गोवृषं दद्याच्चतुर्थे गोद्वयं स्मृतम् ॥ ९.१५ ॥
items.tr:
pāde vastrayugaṃ caiva dvipāde kāṃsyabhājanam |
tripāde govṛṣaṃ dadyāccaturthe godvayaṃ smṛtam || 9.15 ||
items.en: For one quarter he gives a pair of cloths; for two quarters, a bronze vessel; for three quarters, a cow or a bull; for the full penance, two cows.

items.text:
निष्पन्नसर्वगात्रस्तु दृश्यते वा सचेतनः ।
अङ्गप्रत्यङ्गसंपूर्णो द्विगुणं गोव्रतं चरेत् ॥ ९.१६ ॥
items.tr:
niṣpannasarvagātrastu dṛśyate vā sacetanaḥ |
aṅgapratyaṅgasaṃpūrṇo dviguṇaṃ govrataṃ caret || 9.16 ||
items.en: If the foetus has all its limbs fully formed, or is seen to be alive and complete in every limb, he should perform the cow-penance twice over.

items.text:
पाषाणेनाथ दण्डेन गावो येनाभिघातिताः ।
शृङ्गभङ्गे चरेत्पादं द्वौ पादौ नेत्रघातने ॥ ९.१७ ॥
items.tr:
pāṣāṇenātha daṇḍena gāvo yenābhighātitāḥ |
śṛṅgabhaṅge caretpādaṃ dvau pādau netraghātane || 9.17 ||
items.en: If cows are hit with a stone or stick: for breaking a horn he does one quarter of the penance, and for injuring an eye two quarters.

items.text:
लाङ्गूले पादकृच्छ्रं तु द्वौ पादावस्थिभञ्जने ।
त्रिपादं चैव कर्णे तु चरेत्सर्वं निपातने ॥ ९.१८ ॥
items.tr:
lāṅgūle pādakṛcchraṃ tu dvau pādāvasthibhañjane |
tripādaṃ caiva karṇe tu caretsarvaṃ nipātane || 9.18 ||
items.en: For the tail, a quarter Kṛcchra; for breaking a bone, two quarters; for the ear, three quarters; for killing, the whole.

items.text:
शृङ्गभङ्गेऽस्थिभङ्गे च कटिभङ्गे तथैव च ।
यदि जीवति षण्मासान्प्रायश्चित्त्तं न विद्यते ॥ ९.१९ ॥
items.tr:
śṛṅgabhaṅge'sthibhaṅge ca kaṭibhaṅge tathaiva ca |
yadi jīvati ṣaṇmāsānprāyaścitttaṃ na vidyate || 9.19 ||
items.en: If after a broken horn, broken bone or broken hip the cow lives on for six months, no atonement is needed.

items.text:
व्रणभङ्गे च कर्तव्यः स्नेहाभ्यङ्गस्तु पाणिना ।
यवसश्चोपहर्तव्यो यावद्दृढबलो भवेत् ॥ ९.२० ॥
items.tr:
vraṇabhaṅge ca kartavyaḥ snehābhyaṅgastu pāṇinā |
yavasaścopahartavyo yāvaddṛḍhabalo bhavet || 9.20 ||
items.en: If there is a wound or fracture, oil should be rubbed on it by hand, and fodder should be brought until the cow is firm and strong again.

items.text:
यावत्संपूर्णसर्वाङ्गस्तावत्तं पोषयेन्नरः ।
गोरूपं ब्राह्मणस्याग्रे नमस्कृत्वा विसर्जयेत् ॥ ९.२१ ॥
items.tr:
yāvatsaṃpūrṇasarvāṅgastāvattaṃ poṣayennaraḥ |
gorūpaṃ brāhmaṇasyāgre namaskṛtvā visarjayet || 9.21 ||
items.en: The man should feed it until its whole body is healed. Then, after bowing to the cow in front of a Brahmin, he may let it go.
items.note: 'gorūpa' is read as 'the cow'; it could also mean an image of a cow.

items.text:
यद्यसंपूर्णसर्गाङ्गो हीनदेहो भवेत्तदा ।
गोघातकस्य तस्यार्थं प्रायश्चित्तं विनिर्दिशेत् ॥ ९.२२ ॥
items.tr:
yadyasaṃpūrṇasargāṅgo hīnadeho bhavettadā |
goghātakasya tasyārthaṃ prāyaścittaṃ vinirdiśet || 9.22 ||
items.en: If its limbs do not heal and its body stays damaged, then the atonement for a cow-killer should be prescribed for that man.

items.text:
काष्ठलोष्टकपाषाणैः शस्त्रेणैवोद्धतो बलात् ।
व्यापादयति यो गां तु तस्य शुद्धिं विनिर्दिशेत् ॥ ९.२३ ॥
items.tr:
kāṣṭhaloṣṭakapāṣāṇaiḥ śastreṇaivoddhato balāt |
vyāpādayati yo gāṃ tu tasya śuddhiṃ vinirdiśet || 9.23 ||
items.en: When a man, carried away by force of anger, kills a cow with wood, a clod, a stone or a weapon, his purification is prescribed as follows.

items.text:
चरेत्सांतपनं काष्ठे प्राजापत्यं तु लोष्टके ।
तप्तकृच्छ्रं तु पाषाणे सस्त्रे चैवातिकृच्छ्रकम् ॥ ९.२४ ॥
items.tr:
caretsāṃtapanaṃ kāṣṭhe prājāpatyaṃ tu loṣṭake |
taptakṛcchraṃ tu pāṣāṇe sastre caivātikṛcchrakam || 9.24 ||
items.en: For wood he should do Sāntapana; for a clod, Prājāpatya; for a stone, Taptakṛcchra; and for a weapon, Atikṛcchra.
items.note: Sāntapana: a penance of living on pañcagavya (cow products) and kuśa-water followed by a fast. Taptakṛcchra: a penance of taking only hot water, hot milk and hot ghee, then fasting. Atikṛcchra: a harder Kṛcchra taking only one mouthful per meal, then fasting.

items.text:
पञ्च संतपने गावः प्राजापत्ये तथा त्रयः ।
तप्तकृच्छ्रे भवन्त्यष्टावतिकृच्छ्रे त्रयोदश ॥ ९.२५ ॥
items.tr:
pañca saṃtapane gāvaḥ prājāpatye tathā trayaḥ |
taptakṛcchre bhavantyaṣṭāvatikṛcchre trayodaśa || 9.25 ||
items.en: The gift is five cows with Sāntapana, three with Prājāpatya, eight with Taptakṛcchra and thirteen with Atikṛcchra.

items.text:
प्रमापणे प्राणभृतां दद्यात्तत्प्रतिरूपकम् ।
तस्यानुरूपं मूल्यं वा दद्यादित्यब्रवीन्मनुः ॥ ९.२६ ॥
items.tr:
pramāpaṇe prāṇabhṛtāṃ dadyāttatpratirūpakam |
tasyānurūpaṃ mūlyaṃ vā dadyādityabravīnmanuḥ || 9.26 ||
items.en: For killing living creatures, one should give an animal like it, or pay its fair price, said Manu.

items.text:
अन्यत्राङ्कनलक्ष्मभ्यां वाहने मोचने तथा ।
सायं संगोपनार्थं च न दुष्येद्रोधबन्धयोः ॥ ९.२७ ॥
items.tr:
anyatrāṅkanalakṣmabhyāṃ vāhane mocane tathā |
sāyaṃ saṃgopanārthaṃ ca na duṣyedrodhabandhayoḥ || 9.27 ||
items.en: For branding and marking, for yoking and unyoking, and for keeping them safe in the evening, a man is not at fault for penning or tying cows.
items.note: 'anyatra' (except) makes this verse unclear; read here as listing the allowed cases.

items.text:
अतिदाहेऽतिवाहे च नासिकाभेदने तथा ।
नदीपर्वतसंचारे प्रायश्चित्तं विनिर्दिशेत् ॥ ९.२८ ॥
items.tr:
atidāhe'tivāhe ca nāsikābhedane tathā |
nadīparvatasaṃcāre prāyaścittaṃ vinirdiśet || 9.28 ||
items.en: For too much branding, overwork, piercing the nose, or driving them across rivers and mountains, atonement should be prescribed.

items.text:
अतिदाहे चरेत्पादं द्वौ पादौ वाहने चरेत् ।
नासिक्ये पदहीनं तु चरेत्सर्वं निपातने ॥ ९.२९ ॥
items.tr:
atidāhe caretpādaṃ dvau pādau vāhane caret |
nāsikye padahīnaṃ tu caretsarvaṃ nipātane || 9.29 ||
items.en: For too much branding he does one quarter; for overwork, two quarters; for the nose, three quarters; for killing, the whole.

items.text:
दहानात्तु विपद्यते अनड्वान्योक्त्रयन्त्रितः ।
उक्तं पराशरेणैव ह्येकपादं यथाविधि ॥ ९.३० ॥
items.tr:
dahānāttu vipadyate anaḍvānyoktrayantritaḥ |
uktaṃ parāśareṇaiva hyekapādaṃ yathāvidhi || 9.30 ||
items.en: If an ox bound to the yoke dies from burning, Parāśara has said that one quarter should be done according to rule.
items.note: 'dahana' (burning) may refer to branding or to heat; the verse is unclear.

items.text:
रोधनं बन्धनं चैव भारः प्रहरणं तथा ।
दुर्गप्रेरणयोक्त्रं च निमित्तानि वधस्य षट् ॥ ९.३१ ॥
items.tr:
rodhanaṃ bandhanaṃ caiva bhāraḥ praharaṇaṃ tathā |
durgapreraṇayoktraṃ ca nimittāni vadhasya ṣaṭ || 9.31 ||
items.en: Penning, tying, overloading, striking, driving into difficult places, and yoking: these are the six causes of a cow's death.

items.text:
बन्धपाशसुगुप्ताङ्गो म्रियते यदि गोपशुः ।
भवने तस्य पापी स्यात्प्रायश्चित्तार्धं अर्हति ॥ ९.३२ ॥
items.tr:
bandhapāśasuguptāṅgo mriyate yadi gopaśuḥ |
bhavane tasya pāpī syātprāyaścittārdhaṃ arhati || 9.32 ||
items.en: If a cow or other animal dies in a man's house with its body tightly bound by ropes and nooses, he is a sinner and should do half the atonement.

items.text:
न नारिकेलैर्न च शाणवालैः न वापि मौञ्जैर्न च वल्कशृङ्खलैः ।
एतैस्तु गावो न निबन्धनीया बद्ध्वापि तिष्ठेत्परशुं गृहीत्वा ॥ ९.३३ ॥
items.tr:
na nārikelairna ca śāṇavālaiḥ na vāpi mauñjairna ca valkaśṛṅkhalaiḥ |
etaistu gāvo na nibandhanīyā baddhvāpi tiṣṭhetparaśuṃ gṛhītvā || 9.33 ||
items.en: Cows must not be tied with coconut-fibre ropes, hemp or hair ropes, muñja grass ropes, or bark chains. If he does tie them with these, he should stand by holding an axe.
items.note: The axe is to cut the rope at once if the cow is in danger.

items.text:
कुशैः काशैश्च बध्नीयाद्गोपशुं दक्षिणामुखम् ।
पाशलग्नाग्निदग्धासु प्रायश्चित्तं न विद्यते ॥ ९.३४ ॥
items.tr:
kuśaiḥ kāśaiśca badhnīyādgopaśuṃ dakṣiṇāmukham |
pāśalagnāgnidagdhāsu prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate || 9.34 ||
items.en: A cow should be tied facing south, with kuśa or kāśa grass. If it dies caught in such a rope, or burnt by fire, no atonement is needed.
items.note: Kuśa and kāśa: soft sacred grasses.

items.text:
यदि तत्र भवेत्काष्ठं प्रायश्चित्तं कथं भवेत् ।
जपित्वा पावनीं देवीं मुच्यते तत्र किल्बिषात् ॥ ९.३५ ॥
items.tr:
yadi tatra bhavetkāṣṭhaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ bhavet |
japitvā pāvanīṃ devīṃ mucyate tatra kilbiṣāt || 9.35 ||
items.en: If there was a wooden post there, what atonement applies? By reciting the purifying goddess, he is freed from that sin.
items.note: Meaning unclear. 'Purifying goddess' probably means the Gāyatrī.

items.text:
प्रेरयन्कूपवापीषु वृक्षच्छेदेषु पातयन् ।
गवाशनेषु विक्रीणंस्ततः प्राप्नोति गोवधं ॥ ९.३६ ॥
items.tr:
prerayankūpavāpīṣu vṛkṣacchedeṣu pātayan |
gavāśaneṣu vikrīṇaṃstataḥ prāpnoti govadhaṃ || 9.36 ||
items.en: One who drives cows into wells or tanks, fells trees onto them, or sells them to people who eat cows, incurs the sin of cow-killing.

items.text:
आराधितस्तु यः कश्चिद्भिन्नकक्षो यदा भवेत् ।
श्रवणं हृदयं भिन्नं मग्नो वा कूपसंकटे ॥ ९.३७ ॥
items.tr:
ārādhitastu yaḥ kaścidbhinnakakṣo yadā bhavet |
śravaṇaṃ hṛdayaṃ bhinnaṃ magno vā kūpasaṃkaṭe || 9.37 ||
items.en: If a cow being tended gets its flank torn, its ear or heart pierced, or gets stuck in a narrow well,
items.note: 'ārādhita' (tended, cared for) is an unclear word here.

items.text:
कूपादुत्क्रमणे चैव भग्नो वा ग्रीवपादयोः ।
स एव म्रियते तत्र त्रीन्पादांस्तु समाचरेत् ॥ ९.३८ ॥
items.tr:
kūpādutkramaṇe caiva bhagno vā grīvapādayoḥ |
sa eva mriyate tatra trīnpādāṃstu samācaret || 9.38 ||
items.en: … or breaks its neck or legs while climbing out of a well, and dies there, he should do three quarters of the penance.

items.text:
कूपखाटे तटाबन्धे नदीबन्धे प्रपासु च ।
पानीयेषु विपन्नानां प्रायश्चित्तं न विद्यते ॥ ९.३९ ॥
items.tr:
kūpakhāṭe taṭābandhe nadībandhe prapāsu ca |
pānīyeṣu vipannānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate || 9.39 ||
items.en: For cows that die in a well, a tank embankment, a river dam, a water shed or other drinking places, no atonement is needed.

items.text:
कूपखाते तटाखाते दीर्घखाते तथैव च ।
अन्येषु धर्मखातेषु प्रायश्चित्तं न विद्यते ॥ ९.४० ॥
items.tr:
kūpakhāte taṭākhāte dīrghakhāte tathaiva ca |
anyeṣu dharmakhāteṣu prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate || 9.40 ||
items.en: For wells, tanks, long channels and other pits dug as a charitable act, no atonement is needed.

items.text:
वेश्मद्वारे निवासेषु यो नरः खातं इच्छति ।
स्वकार्यगृहखतेषु प्रायश्चित्तं विनिर्दिशेत् ॥ ९.४१ ॥
items.tr:
veśmadvāre nivāseṣu yo naraḥ khātaṃ icchati |
svakāryagṛhakhateṣu prāyaścittaṃ vinirdiśet || 9.41 ||
items.en: If a man digs a pit at the door of his house or where people live, for his own purposes, atonement should be prescribed (if a cow dies in it).

items.text:
निशि बन्धनिरुद्धेषु सर्पव्याघ्रहतेषु च ।
अग्निविद्युद्विपन्नानां प्रायश्चित्तं न विद्यते ॥ ९.४२ ॥
items.tr:
niśi bandhaniruddheṣu sarpavyāghrahateṣu ca |
agnividyudvipannānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate || 9.42 ||
items.en: For cows that die at night while tied or penned, that are killed by snakes or tigers, or that die by fire or lightning, no atonement is needed.

items.text:
ग्रामघाते शरौघेण वेश्मभङ्गान्निपातने ।
अतिवृष्टिहतानां च प्रायश्चित्तं न विद्यते ॥ ९.४३ ॥
items.tr:
grāmaghāte śaraugheṇa veśmabhaṅgānnipātane |
ativṛṣṭihatānāṃ ca prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate || 9.43 ||
items.en: For cows killed by showers of arrows in an attack on the village, by a house collapsing, or by too much rain, no atonement is needed.

items.text:
संग्रामे प्रहतानां च ये दग्धा वेश्मकेषु च ।
दावाग्निग्रामघातेषु प्रायश्चित्तं न विद्याते ॥ ९.४४ ॥
items.tr:
saṃgrāme prahatānāṃ ca ye dagdhā veśmakeṣu ca |
dāvāgnigrāmaghāteṣu prāyaścittaṃ na vidyāte || 9.44 ||
items.en: For cows struck down in battle, burnt in houses, or killed in forest fires or village raids, no atonement is needed.

items.text:
यन्त्रिता गौश्चिकित्सार्थं मूढगर्भविमोचने ।
यत्ने कृते विपद्येत प्रायश्चित्तं न विद्यते ॥ ९.४५ ॥
items.tr:
yantritā gauścikitsārthaṃ mūḍhagarbhavimocane |
yatne kṛte vipadyeta prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate || 9.45 ||
items.en: If a cow is restrained for medical treatment or to remove a stuck calf and dies despite every effort, no atonement is needed.

items.text:
व्यापन्नानां बहूनां च बन्धने रोधनेऽपि वा ।
भिषङ्मिथ्योपचारे च प्रायश्चित्तं विनिर्दिशेत् ॥ ९.४६ ॥
items.tr:
vyāpannānāṃ bahūnāṃ ca bandhane rodhane'pi vā |
bhiṣaṅmithyopacāre ca prāyaścittaṃ vinirdiśet || 9.46 ||
items.en: If many cows die while tied or penned, or from a doctor's wrong treatment, atonement should be prescribed.

items.text:
गोवृषाणां विपत्तौ च यावन्तः प्रेक्षका जनाः ।
अनिवारयतां तेषां सर्वेषां पातकं भवेत् ॥ ९.४७ ॥
items.tr:
govṛṣāṇāṃ vipattau ca yāvantaḥ prekṣakā janāḥ |
anivārayatāṃ teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pātakaṃ bhavet || 9.47 ||
items.en: When cows or bulls are being killed, all the people who watch and do not stop it share in the sin.

items.text:
एको हतो यैर्बहुभिः समेतैर्न ज्ञायते यस्य हतोऽभिघातात् ।
दिव्येन तेषां उपलभ्य हन्ता निवर्तनीयो नृपसंनियुक्तैः ॥ ९.४८ ॥
items.tr:
eko hato yairbahubhiḥ sametairna jñāyate yasya hato'bhighātāt |
divyena teṣāṃ upalabhya hantā nivartanīyo nṛpasaṃniyuktaiḥ || 9.48 ||
items.en: If one cow is killed by many men together and no one knows whose blow killed it, the king's officers should find the killer by an ordeal and punish him.
items.note: Ordeal (divya): a 'divine test' such as fire or water, believed to reveal guilt.

items.text:
एका चेद्बहुभिः काचिद्दैवाद्व्यापादिता यदि ।
पादं पादं तु हत्यायाश्चरेयुस्ते पृथक्पृथक् ॥ ९.४९ ॥
items.tr:
ekā cedbahubhiḥ kāciddaivādvyāpāditā yadi |
pādaṃ pādaṃ tu hatyāyāścareyuste pṛthakpṛthak || 9.49 ||
items.en: If one cow is killed by many men by accident, each of them should separately do one quarter of the penance for cow-killing.

items.text:
हते तु रुधिरं दृश्यं व्याधिग्रस्तः कृशो भवेत् ।
लाला भवति दष्टेषु एवं अन्वेषणं भवेत् ॥ ९.५० ॥
items.tr:
hate tu rudhiraṃ dṛśyaṃ vyādhigrastaḥ kṛśo bhavet |
lālā bhavati daṣṭeṣu evaṃ anveṣaṇaṃ bhavet || 9.50 ||
items.en: When a cow is killed, blood is seen; when it is sick, it becomes thin; when it is bitten by a snake, there is froth. This is how the cause is found.

items.text:
ग्रासार्थं चोदितो वापि अध्वानं नैव गच्छति ।
मनुना चैवं एकेन सर्वशास्त्राणि जानता ॥ ९.५१ ॥
items.tr:
grāsārthaṃ codito vāpi adhvānaṃ naiva gacchati |
manunā caivaṃ ekena sarvaśāstrāṇi jānatā || 9.51 ||
items.en: Or, even when urged with food, it does not walk on the road. Manu alone, who knew all the śāstras,

items.text:
प्रायश्चित्तं तु तेनोक्तं गोघ्नश्चान्द्रायणं चरेत् ।
केशानां रक्षणार्थाय द्विगुणं व्रतं आचरेत् ॥ ९.५२ ॥
items.tr:
prāyaścittaṃ tu tenoktaṃ goghnaścāndrāyaṇaṃ caret |
keśānāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya dviguṇaṃ vrataṃ ācaret || 9.52 ||
items.en: … has declared this atonement: the cow-killer should perform Cāndrāyaṇa. If he wants to keep his hair, he should do the vow twice over.
items.note: Cāndrāyaṇa: a month-long penance where daily food follows the moon, one mouthful less each day as the moon wanes and one more as it waxes.

items.text:
द्विगुणे व्रत आदिष्टे द्विगुणा दक्षिणा भवेत् ।
राजा वा राजपुत्रो वा ब्राह्मणो वा बहुश्रुतः ॥ ९.५३ ॥
items.tr:
dviguṇe vrata ādiṣṭe dviguṇā dakṣiṇā bhavet |
rājā vā rājaputro vā brāhmaṇo vā bahuśrutaḥ || 9.53 ||
items.en: When a double vow is prescribed, the dakṣiṇā is also double. For a king, a prince or a very learned Brahmin,

items.text:
अकृत्वा वपनं तस्य प्रायश्चित्तं विनिर्दिशेत् ।
सर्वान्केशान्समुद्धृत्य च्छेदयेदङ्गुलद्वयं ॥ ९.५४ ॥
items.tr:
akṛtvā vapanaṃ tasya prāyaścittaṃ vinirdiśet |
sarvānkeśānsamuddhṛtya cchedayedaṅguladvayaṃ || 9.54 ||
items.en: … the atonement may be prescribed without shaving. Gathering up all the hair, one should cut off two finger-widths.

items.text:
एवं नारीकुमारीणां शिरसो मुण्डनं स्मृतम् ।
न स्त्रियाः केशवपनं न दूरे शयनाशनं ॥ ९.५५ ॥
items.tr:
evaṃ nārīkumārīṇāṃ śiraso muṇḍanaṃ smṛtam |
na striyāḥ keśavapanaṃ na dūre śayanāśanaṃ || 9.55 ||
items.en: This is the 'shaving' of the head for women and girls. A woman's head is not shaved, and she does not sleep and eat far from home,

items.text:
न च गोष्ठे वसेद्रात्रौ न दिवा गा अनुव्रजेत् ।
नदीषु संगमे चैव अरण्येषु विशेषतः ॥ ९.५६ ॥
items.tr:
na ca goṣṭhe vasedrātrau na divā gā anuvrajet |
nadīṣu saṃgame caiva araṇyeṣu viśeṣataḥ || 9.56 ||
items.en: … nor stay in the cow-pen at night, nor follow the cows by day, nor go to rivers, river meeting points, and especially forests.

items.text:
न स्त्रीणां अजिनं वासो व्रतं एव समाचरेत् ।
त्रिसंध्यं स्नानं इत्युक्तं सुराणां अर्चनं तथा ॥ ९.५७ ॥
items.tr:
na strīṇāṃ ajinaṃ vāso vrataṃ eva samācaret |
trisaṃdhyaṃ snānaṃ ityuktaṃ surāṇāṃ arcanaṃ tathā || 9.57 ||
items.en: Women do not wear deerskin; they only perform the vow. Bathing at dawn, noon and dusk and worship of the gods are prescribed for them.

items.text:
बन्धुमध्ये व्रतं तासां कृच्छ्रचान्द्रायणादिकम् ।
गृहेषु सततं तिष्ठेच्छुचिर्नियमं आचरेत् ॥ ९.५८ ॥
items.tr:
bandhumadhye vrataṃ tāsāṃ kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādikam |
gṛheṣu satataṃ tiṣṭhecchucirniyamaṃ ācaret || 9.58 ||
items.en: Their vows, such as Kṛcchra and Cāndrāyaṇa, are done among their relatives. They should stay at home all the time, keep pure and follow the rules.

items.text:
इह यो गोवधं कृत्वा प्रच्छादयितुं इच्छति ।
स याति नरकं घोरं कालसूत्रं असंशयं ॥ ९.५९ ॥
items.tr:
iha yo govadhaṃ kṛtvā pracchādayituṃ icchati |
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ kālasūtraṃ asaṃśayaṃ || 9.59 ||
items.en: Whoever kills a cow in this world and tries to hide it goes, without doubt, to the terrible hell called Kālasūtra.
items.note: Kālasūtra: 'the black thread', a named hell.

items.text:
विमुक्तो नरकात्तस्मान्मर्त्यलोके प्रजायते ।
क्लीबो दुःखी च कुष्ठी च सप्त जन्मानि वै नरः ॥ ९.६० ॥
items.tr:
vimukto narakāttasmānmartyaloke prajāyate |
klībo duḥkhī ca kuṣṭhī ca sapta janmāni vai naraḥ || 9.60 ||
items.en: Released from that hell, he is born in the human world for seven lives as an impotent, miserable man with leprosy.

items.text:
तस्मात्प्रकाशयेत्पापं स्वधर्मं सततं चरेत् ।
स्त्रीबालभृत्यगोविप्रेष्वतिकोपं विवर्जयेत् ॥ ९.६१ ॥
items.tr:
tasmātprakāśayetpāpaṃ svadharmaṃ satataṃ caret |
strībālabhṛtyagovipreṣvatikopaṃ vivarjayet || 9.61 ||
items.en: So one should make one's sin known and always follow one's own dharma. One should avoid great anger toward women, children, servants, cows and Brahmins.
